question.text: Which of the following exchanges offers exchange-traded currency derivatives in India?

explanation.text: The Logic: Pages 21 and 127 of the NISM Series I Currency Derivatives workbook (December 2025) state that exchange-traded currency derivatives in India trade on NSE, BSE, and the Metropolitan Stock Exchange of India Ltd. (MSEI). These are the three recognised exchanges for the Currency Derivatives Segment. The Trap: The other options omit MSEI or include exchanges that are not listed as currency-derivative venues in the source pages. Note: Claims about MCX/NCDEX handling commodity (vs currency) derivatives and any market-share ranking between NSE and BSE are not stated on pages 21, 127, or 158 of this workbook and are not used here.
